scope: Scoring-only holdout. Never include in Agent prompts, evidence stores or run workspaces. Qualitative decisions require independent adjudication.

CONF-PIT-01.rationale: The information became available on February 4, after the February 3 decision. The December observation date does not establish historical availability.

CONF-RETURNS-01.rationale: The report says 15% net while the archived net result is 12%, a 3 percentage-point difference; the result definition says fees are included.

CONF-SUPPORT-01.rationale: Eighteen in-sample sessions and no independent out-of-sample trials cannot establish a guarantee of future outperformance.

CONF-CLEAN-01.rationale: The report agrees with the archived net result and the data was available before the decision. Pass applies only to the declared required categories.

CONF-FALSE-ALARM-01.rationale: The frozen result definition explicitly identifies the return as net and fees-inclusive. The allegation that fees were excluded is unsupported.

CONF-MISSING-01.rationale: The return result does not establish when the underlying information became available. PIT must remain unverified without timing evidence.

CONF-STALE-01.rationale: A review tied to candidate revision 1 cannot approve candidate revision 2, even though the numeric result is unchanged.
